meta.name: codex-plugins-guide
meta.description: This skill should be loaded when creating or modifying a Codex plugin manifest (.codex-plugin/plugin.json), registering a plugin in the Codex marketplace (.agents/plugins/marketplace.json), adding interface metadata, troubleshooting Codex plugin discovery, or troubleshooting subagent role discovery. Defines Codex-specific marketplace conventions for this repository.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按仓库约定配置 Codex 插件并注册到市场
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想在 Codex 中开发或发布自己的插件
copy.tagline_en: Configure Codex plugin manifests and register them in the marketplace per repo conventions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building or shipping plugins for Codex

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按预检校验器的规范,帮你撰写或修改 Codex 插件清单(plugin.json)和 marketplace.json,并说明插件组件(技能、代理、钩子等)的配置规则。
howto.when: 当用户创建或修改 Codex 插件清单、在 marketplace 注册插件、排查插件或子代理的发现问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 preflight 规范写一个 Codex 插件 manifest。
这个 plugin.json 的 interface 里哪些字段是必填?
say.note: 会列出 interface 的必填与可选子字段。

say.text: 检查 marketplace.json 里插件 source 写法对不对。
say.note: 会核对路径、source 类型与策略字段。

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude follows the preflight validator's contract to help write or edit Codex plugin manifests (plugin.json) and marketplace.json, and explains configuration conventions for plugin components (skills, agents, hooks, etc.).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user creates or modifies a Codex plugin manifest, registers a plugin in a marketplace, or troubleshoots plugin or subagent discovery issues.

say_en.text: Help me write a Codex plugin manifest following the preflight validator's contract.
say_en.note: Claude generates plugin.json per the validator.

say_en.text: Which interface fields are required in this plugin.json?
Check whether the plugin source entries in marketplace.json are valid.
say_en.note: Validates paths, source types, and policy fields.
